message.content: BILL-81: plan the invoices table upgrade to Postgres 17 with no downtime.

content.text: Logical replication from 15 to 17, then a cutover: stop writes for a few seconds, wait for lag to hit zero, flip the connection string. The invoice_lines index rebuild is the slow part, so it runs on the replica before cutover.
Runbook is in docs/runbooks/pg17-cutover.md with the rollback step: keep the 15 primary read-only for 24 hours so we can point back at it.
